run.platform: Web, Microsoft Edge (Chromium, headless), 390x844 touch, persistent browser profile
run.access_mode: Playwright (scripts/playthrough.mjs): real clicks in the solution order, read from the screen; save read after every level. Logged economy aid: 500 debug gems spent on the 8x speed tier in the Speed Store
run.scope: All content: 5 themes x 3 difficulties x 6 levels + 12 Halloween event levels (102), rewards and stars after every win, unlock order, persistence after every section, event reward track, end state
run.summary: Completed 102/102 levels from a fresh install, every one won on its first attempt with 3 stars, in 1 h 34 min (1 h 12 min of actual play). Rewards, stars, unlocks, saves and the event reward track were all correct. One major bug: player XP never grows, so after 102 wins the player is still level 1 and the Firefly bug and two avatars can never be unlocked by playing.

coverage.notes: 849 s of play (includes the tutorial level at 1x)
767 s of play. Level 10 was played twice: its first win was lost when the test harness was stopped mid-write (not a game bug); the reconcile step replayed it
491 s of play; +10 pumpkins per win (120); all 5 rewards paid as listed (500 coins, 50 gems, 1,500 coins, 100 gems, 3,000 coins + 200 gems); a second claim is refused

Every win paid exactly 30 / 45 / 60 coins (4,590 in total = coinsEarned in the save), stars saved = stars shown, and the next level / difficulty opened as the rules say. Details per level in inventory.md.
Reload after each section: progress kept. One more check (sweets-medium 3/4) was taken while the harness had lost a write and is not counted.
Gallery 'Completed 102/102', 6/6 levels in all 15 sections, event 12/12, stats.levels 102, 0 page errors.

findings.title: Player XP never grows: after 102 wins the player is still level 1, so the Firefly bug and two avatars can never be unlocked
findings.environment: Run 1: the save after all 102 levels. Run 2: a fresh player winning 3 levels
findings.expected: Wins give XP, the player levels up (the Profile promises 'Next reward: 50' coins) and level-gated content opens: Firefly at level 5, avatars at levels 10 and 20
findings.actual: XP stays 1/2 and the player stays level 1 after 1, 2, 3 and 102 wins. The Firefly and all 7 of its looks say 'Unlocks at player level 5'; two avatars stay locked.

evidence.caption: After 102 wins: Profile at level 1, Firefly locked
playerLevel 1 / xp 1 after 102 wins, and after 1-3 wins on a fresh player
The only code that raises playerLevel is the debug 'levelup' / 'xp' commands; nothing adds state.xp
const LEVEL_UP_REWARD = 50 (shown in the Profile, never paid)

findings.suspected_cause: The XP / level-up logic was never wired to gameplay: track('level') counts wins but does not add XP, and no code outside the debug menu changes playerLevel.
findings.suggested_fix: In track('level') add XP per win (e.g. 1 per star), level up when xp >= xpToNext (grow xpToNext, pay LEVEL_UP_REWARD, show a toast), then re-render the HUD.
